messages:
Morgan (Support): Heads up — we just got two separate support tickets asking for per-tenant rate limits from the same ACME contact. Seems like duplicates.
Alex (PM): Can you paste both asks here? Do they differ on scope or urgency?
Morgan (Support): One asks 'soft limits per tenant' to avoid noisy tenants, the other asks 'hard quotas with billing integration'. Both from acct-team@acme.
Sam (Sales): ACME is on an expansion contract. They flagged reliability issues under load. This is high-dollar and they want guaranteed isolation.
Riley (Eng): Need clarification: soft limits (throttling) vs hard quotas (enforced/chargeback) are different impls. Which one has traction?
Morgan (Support): Customer initially said throttling; later PM mentioned chargeback. They used the words interchangeably.
Sarah (TPM): Proposal: merge into one canonical request: "Per-tenant rate limiting primitives (soft throttles + optional hard quota hooks) + billing hook/usage export." Tag as cust-ask + dup-merged. Assign tentative priority = P1-customer (revenue-sensitive).
triage-bot: detected potential duplicate threads (confidence 0.82). Suggested canonical thread id = 1812345678.
Alex (PM): Sounds right. Let's not commit to billing hooks in the initial MVP. Scope for launch: soft throttles + tenant scoping + usage metrics export. Billing integration as follow-up.
Sam (Sales): Customer will accept phased approach if we give a clear timeline. Can we commit to an ETA for the soft throttle MVP?
Riley (Eng): Rough estimate: 2 sprints for throttling + tenant scoping, additional sprint for metrics export. Billing hook needs design work.
Alex (PM): Ok. Action plan: 1) Merge tickets and post canonical ask to ACME (Morgan) 2) Tag backlog item with: [cust-ask, dup-merged:1812345678, prio:P1] (Sarah) 3) Eng to size and create tech spec (Riley) 4) PM to set launch criteria and timeline (Alex).
Morgan (Support): I'll merge and send a single message to the ACME rep. Draft reply: ```Hi Chris — thanks for the reports. We've consolidated your requests into one feature ask: "Per-tenant rate limiting (soft throttles) with optional usage export; billing integration later." We'll confirm scope & ETA by EOW. Is that OK?```
Sarah (TPM): Minor edit: add "temporary mitigations" in the reply so they know we can add guardrails sooner. e.g., "We can also propose immediate mitigation steps (config changes, rate-limiting rules) while we scope the feature."
Alex (PM): Good. Morgan please send with Sarah's sentence and cc Sam. Update the backlog with the tags and link the merged ticket id.
Morgan (Support): Will do. Leaving a note for the triage log: merged tickets 1812345601 + 1812345629 -> canonical 1812345678.
triage-bot: Logged merge event. Reaction: :white_check_mark:
Riley (Eng): I'll start a lightweight spec doc and post to #eng-runtime by EOD Monday.
Sam (Sales): I'll tell ACME we aim for initial ETA in ~4 weeks (tentative).
Alex (PM): Thanks all. We'll track this under the "tenant isolation" initiative and review in next roadmap sync.
Sarah (TPM): Assigning owners: Morgan -> customer comms; Riley -> tech spec + estimate; Alex -> launch criteria + prioritization.
Morgan (Support): Done. Sent merged message and updated ticket.
Alex (PM): Marking thread resolved for now. Follow-ups in the product ticket. :thumbsup:
